# OpenUSD test cases

`museum/` holds a few of OpenUSD's Pcp museum cases
(`pxr/usd/pcp/testenv/testPcpMuseum_*.testenv`, release v26.08), unchanged:
each case's layers and, as `expected.txt`, the composition results OpenUSD's
`testPcpCompositionResults.py --usd` prints for its `root.usda`. They are
copyright Pixar and licensed under the Tomorrow Open Source Technology
License 1.0 (`licenses/OPENUSD-TOST-1.0.txt` at the repository root); see
`NOTICE`. The full museum is checked locally (docs/PARITY.md).
